attributes.title: [Metrics Qdrant] Overview
attributes.description: Qdrant vector database: REST traffic, errors and response time, collection size, optimizations and update queue, replicas, shard transfers, snapshots and memory.

params.markdown:
## [Metrics Qdrant] Overview

Metrics scraped from the Qdrant `/metrics` endpoint.

- **REST API**: requests by endpoint and status, server errors, response time
- **Collections**: points per collection, running optimizations, update queue
- **Cluster**: dead replicas, shard transfers, snapshots, memory

An update queue that keeps growing means indexing does not keep up with writes. Dead replicas or failed shard transfers need attention before the next node failure.

TS metrics-qdrant.metrics-*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "qdrant.metrics"
| STATS points = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(qdrant.collection.points))

TS metrics-qdrant.metrics-*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "qdrant.metrics"
| STATS rps = SUM(RATE(qdrant.rest.responses.count))

TS metrics-qdrant.metrics-*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "qdrant.metrics"
| STATS rps = SUM(RATE(qdrant.rest.responses.count))

TS metrics-qdrant.metrics-*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "qdrant.metrics"
| STATS rps = SUM(RATE(qdrant.rest.responses.count)) BY qdrant.labels.status
| EVAL is_5xx = CASE(STARTS_WITH(qdrant.labels.status, "5"), rps, 0.0)
| STATS errors = SUM(is_5xx), total = SUM(rps)
| EVAL ratio = CASE(total > 0, errors / total, 0.0)
| KEEP ratio
